stances.summary: Honors Jesse Jackson's civil rights legacy
stances.quote: Every time we overcome prejudice, discrimination, voter suppression, and other man-made barriers to opportunity, we should remember and thank Rev. Jesse Jackson for working to blaze a trail to the American Dream for all people. May he rest in peace.

stances.summary: Supported federal oversight of southern voting laws
stances.quote:
Section 5 of the 1965 Voting Rights Act basically said, based on their history, we cannot trust southern states to do right by black voters.  Therefore, any changes to voting laws had to be approved by the federal government.

stances.summary: Praises Mueller's leadership and personal integrity
stances.quote: FBI Director Robert Mueller understood the assignment. He led the FBI and modeled his life on the principles of “Fidelity, Bravery, and Integrity.” America, we don’t have to settle for unprincipled and undisciplined people. Mueller never compromised American values for selfish ga

stances.summary: Accuses Republicans of protecting child predators
stances.quote: It’s a little late for elected Republicans to take a moral high ground. Overwhelmingly, they have rallied to protect rich child sexual predators. Raping children was once considered the worst of the worst. Clean them all out, from the White House, to the Senate, to the House.

stances.summary: Suggests UK handle Epstein investigation independently
stances.quote: Perhaps the U.S. Department of Justice should allow the United Kingdom to handle the Epstein investigation and hold all co-conspirators accountable. Then they wouldn't have to worry about covering up for the president. nytimes.com/live/2026/02/19/…

Ghislaine Maxwell, a convicted child molester and Donald Trump associate, is in a minimum security facility playing with puppies, because she promised to keep her mouth shut.

Remember America, “no lie can live forever.” Stand up for the victims.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump pardoning January 6 Capitol attackers
stances.quote:
Trump is giving your taxpayer dollars to violent criminals who attacked police on Jan 6. He says "in my world, loyalty outranks law. They broke the rules for me."

This is insane.

He's getting geared up to create more chaos to try to stop you from voting.

He underestimates us.

stances.summary: Calls for thorough investigation of Minneapolis shooting
stances.quote:
Sad to hear about the tragic shooting in Minneapolis. 
It’s early and a thorough investigation must take place. However, based on what I do know so far, if this shooting happened on my watch as a police chief, I would be extremely worried about the justification and the outcome.

stances.summary: Criticizes Netanyahu's strikes, warns of endless war
stances.quote: The fact that Netanyahu continues to strike Lebanon is a clear sign that Netanyahu dragged President Trump and the United States into this forever war without a clear plan for a U.S. victory. The Strait of Hormuz remains closed. Pray for our troops.

stances.summary: Contrasts Obama family integrity with Trump character
stances.quote:
In response to Trump's sad post about the Obamas, let me say this:
President and First Lady Obama have more class and intellect in one day than Donald Trump could muster up in a lifetime. Perhaps no one knows that more than him. Had enough yet America?

stances.summary: Demands investigation into ICE agent shootings
stances.quote: Two U.S. citizens have been killed by ICE agents under extremely questionable circumstances. No investigation, no accountability. All part of the President's attempt to confiscate voter rolls. Believe your eyes and ears and stand up and speak out against what we know is wrong.

stances.summary: Calls for suspension of routine ICE operations
stances.quote: All routine ICE Operations should be suspended. Two Americans are dead. The use of deadly force is not a time to "just move on." More may be killed. Suspend and investigate. This is out of control. nbcnews.com/news/us-news/min…

stances.summary: Seeks independent review before resuming ICE operations
stances.quote: Immigration laws matter. HOWEVER, due to the recent shootings and questions about ICE’s authority, recruiting, and training,  all routine operations in communities should be suspended until an independent review. ICE should always coordinate with local law enforcement.

stances.summary: Questions ICE authority and denies absolute immunity
stances.quote: A young mother has been shot and killed. Everyone, regardless of the outcome of a “legitimate” investigation, should feel bad about that, including POTUS, VP, and Ice. Contrary to the VP’s reckless claim, ICE does not have “absolute immunity.” Heaven help us.
